description: NaInBP₂HO₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.81 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra and corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.25 Å. B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one InO₆ octahedra and corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.49 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-49°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.59 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent BO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.58 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one In, one B, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one B and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one P atom.
